notes.title: PATCH 4 Final Mission pack, 2 New playable ships,
notes.content:
Patch 4
Additions
- Added the last mission pack along with some new enemies and bosses
- Added New ship "Great Tanker" (Very similar to the SS Total Unit, but slower, does more damage, and has more health)
- Added New ship "Nimble Fighter" (Entirely different from the other ships, it is a small ship that is very fast and has a small amount of health, and has pretty much no long range weapons, but has very powerful short range weapons. It is also the only ship with 700 max shield)
- Added Engine Exhaust to all ships
- Added Unique sound to the Rocket Launcher when it is shot
- Added Rocket Sound

Changes
- When a rocket is shot or exploded, It will explode into a nuke.
- Increased shield pickup from 10 to 25
- Changed default kamikaze ship damage from 25 to 20
- Made max shield 600

Removals
- Removed Turrets 

Upcoming
- New ship "Pyrotechnic" (Similar to the Nimble Fighter, but all weapons are replaced with flamethrowers and explosive weapons)
- Reworked turrets
- Modules
- Secret Levels
- Early Access Finish!

notes.title: Tachyonest: Rewrite Public Branch Release (April 22, 2024)
notes.content:
Additions

- Added Shields
- Added "Spitfire" Shotgun
- Added "Surgical" DMR
- Added Ammunition system
- Added Item indication
- Added radial Health indicator
- Added radial Ammo indicator
- Added bullet spread
- Added 1 HP Lock in (When you are lowered to below one health, you are put at 1 HP and put in a slightly stronger position, but you are unable to regenerate health for the rest of the level)

Removals

- Removed Sniper

Changes

- Decreased minigun damage from 2 to 1
- Decreased minigun recoil
- Decreased minigun windup time

i hope you guys are happy with this!!!
